description: LOWELL, Mass. (Feb. 4, 2020) – Democrat Lori Trahan proudly announced the endorsement of the International Union of Painters and Allied Trades District Council 35 in her re-election bid to represent Massachusetts’ Third Congressional District. IUPAT DC #35 represents nearly 4,000 workers in the New England area. In a statement of support for Rep. Trahan, […]

title: Representative Lori Trahan Congresswoman Lori Trahan was born and raised in a working-class family in Lowell, Massachusetts. She is the mom of two young girls and proudly represents Massachusetts' 3rd Congressional District.
